snippet.title: 1348 Ex Voto Launch Trailer - Future Games Show Spring Showcase 2026
snippet.description:
A new launch trailer provided a window into the world of 1348 Ex Voto, an action-adventure where you play as a knight-errant in Medieval Italy. The game stars Alby Baldwin and Jennifer English, and it's out today on PlayStation and PC.

Wishlist now: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1895900/1348_Ex_Voto/

https://www.youtube.com/@FutureGamesShow

#FutureGamesShow #FGS

Future Publishing uses the Epidemic Sound Library, Getty Image Library, Shutterstock Image Library, Motion Array and Adobe Creative Cloud
